_comment: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — cleaned-verbatim narration derived from inputs/guide_transcript.txt. Every line keeps the consultant's own wording and structure; only fillers, mis-steps and digressions are removed and terminology corrected. Compare narration against source_excerpt to see exactly what the clean did. S06 is a deliberate [GAP].

objectives.text: Raise a purchase requisition for a stocked item from the Fiori launchpad
Assign a cost centre so the requisition releases for approval

glossary.note: The client's term throughout. 'PR' is acceptable spoken only after the first full use.
British spelling, per the client style guide

scenes.source_excerpt: Okay so this is the launchpad, and everything we need is under Procurement. There are two tiles people mix up — Create Purchase Requisition, which is what we want, and My Requisitions which is just the list of ones you've already raised.
scenes.narration: This is the launchpad, and everything we need is under Procurement. There are two tiles people mix up: Create Purchase Requisition, which is what we want, and My Requisitions, which is the list of ones you've already raised.

scenes.source_excerpt: Right, so Create Purchase Requisition. First line, material number goes in here. And you'll see the description and the unit of measure come through on their own, that's from the material master, so don't type over those. People do try and they get a validation error they don't understand.
scenes.narration: So, Create Purchase Requisition. First line, the material number goes in here. You'll see the description and the unit of measure come through on their own. That's from the material master, so don't type over those. People do try, and they get a validation error they don't understand.

scenes.source_excerpt: Now the important bit, account assignment. Cost centre. This is mandatory for anything stocked, and if you leave it blank the requisition just sits there — it won't release for approval and there's no error message telling you why, which is the number one thing the service desk gets called about. The G/L account fills itself in once the cost centre is there.
scenes.narration: Now the important bit: account assignment, cost centre. This is mandatory for anything stocked. If you leave it blank the requisition just sits there. It won't release for approval, and there's no error message telling you why, which is the number one thing the service desk gets called about.

scenes.source_excerpt: And then save, and it takes a moment.
Right, there we go, that's saved and it's gone off for approval.
scenes.gap_note: The consultant says it has 'gone off for approval' but never says to whom, and the approval status chip is truncated at the frame edge, so the recording does not establish the routing either. Consultant to confirm the routing rule for stocked items before this scene is narrated.

scenes.source_excerpt: And that's your requisition number at the top, four five zero zero zero zero one two three four. You can check where it's got to under My Requisitions. Usually it moves overnight, so if it's still sitting there the next day, that's when you raise a ticket.
